eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player, w = g.weapon, inp = g.input, t = g.tools; g.edits.clear(); window.__tick = (n) => { for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { p.update(1 / 30); w.update(1 / 30); t.update(1 / 30); g.felled.update(1 / 30, p.position); g.particles.update(1 / 30); inp.endFrame(); } }; const cands = []; for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) c.treeRefs.forEach((r, k) => { if (r && (r.kind === 'conifer' || r.kind === 'broadleaf')) cands.push({ r, x: c.trunks[k * 4], z: c.trunks[k * 4 + 1], d: Math.hypot(c.trunks[k * 4] - p.position.x, c.trunks[k * 4 + 1] - p.position.z) }); }); cands.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d); const T = cands.find((q) => { const ux = (p.position.x - q.x) / q.d, uz = (p.position.z - q.z) / q.d; q.px = q.x + ux * (q.r.radius + 1.2); q.pz = q.z + uz * (q.r.radius + 1.2); return g.chunks.isClear(q.px, q.pz, 0.45) && g.terrain.places.clear(q.px, q.pz, 2); }); p.position.set(T.px, g.terrain.heightAt(T.px, T.pz), T.pz); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(T.x - T.px), -(T.z - T.pz)); p.pitch = -0.1; const ch = g.chunks.chunkAt(T.x, T.z); const snapshot = ch.treeRefs.map((r, k) => r && r.id !== T.r.id ? r.id + '@' + ch.trunks[k * 4].toFixed(3) + ',' + ch.trunks[k * 4 + 1].toFixed(3) : null).filter(Boolean).join('|'); window.__T = { id: T.r.id, x: T.x, z: T.z, snapshot, bushes: ch.layers[4].count, rocks: ch.rocks.join(',') }; localStorage.setItem('__T', JSON.stringify(window.__T)); __tick(5); return { arvore: { id: T.r.id, especie: T.r.kind, escala: +T.r.scale.toFixed(2), raio: +T.r.radius.toFixed(2), golpesEsperados: g.tools.constructor.hitsFor(T.r.radius) }, distanciaAoTronco: +Math.hypot(p.position.x - T.x, p.position.z - T.z).toFixed(2) }; })()

'caiu'); } return { golpes, progresso: log, cortada: g.edits.cut.has(T.id), caindo: g.felled.falling, municaoIgual: g.weapon.magazine === bala, derrubadasGuardadas: g.edits.felled.length }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, T = window.__T; const ch = g.chunks.chunkAt(T.x, T.z); let toco = null; ch.treeRefs.forEach((r, k) => { if (Math.hypot(ch.trunks[k * 4] - T.x, ch.trunks[k * 4 + 1] - T.z) < 0.01) toco = { cortavel: !!r, alturaDoToco: +(ch.trunks[k * 4 + 3] - g.terrain.heightAt(T.x, T.z)).toFixed(2) }; }); const snap = ch.treeRefs.map((r, k) => r && r.id !== T.id ? r.id + '@' + ch.trunks[k * 4].toFixed(3) + ',' + ch.trunks[k * 4 + 1].toFixed(3) : null).filter(Boolean).join('|'); const t0 = performance.now(); g.chunks.repopulate(T.x, T.z); const ms = performance.now() - t0; return { tocoNoLugar: toco, arvoreSumiu: !ch.treeRefs.some((r) => r && r.id === T.id), restoDoChunkIgual: snap === T.snapshot, arbustosIguais: ch.layers[4].count === T.bushes, pedrasIguais: ch.rocks.join(',') === T.rocks, repovoarMs: +ms.toFixed(2), guardado: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('birdkiller.obras.' + g.world.seed)).cut }; })()
label: toco no lugar, o resto do chunk idêntico

eval: (() => { const g = game, T = window.__T, p = g.player; p.pitch = -0.45; p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(T.x - p.position.x), -(T.z - p.position.z)); __tick(6); const alvo = g.tools.targetWood; const acao = document.querySelector('.hud-action').textContent; g.input.pressed.add('KeyE'); __tick(3); return { alvoNaMira: alvo, acao, madeira: g.edits.wood, derrubadasNoChao: g.edits.felled.length, aviso: document.querySelector('.hud-kill').textContent, placar: document.querySelector('.hud-score').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, p = g.player; const all = []; for (const c of g.chunks.loaded.values()) for (const l of c.logs) all.push(l); all.sort((a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - p.position.x, a.z - p.position.z) - Math.hypot(b.x - p.position.x, b.z - p.position.z)); const L = all.find((l) => { l.px = l.x - l.dz * 1.8; l.pz = l.z + l.dx * 1.8; return g.chunks.isClear(l.px, l.pz, 0.45); }); p.position.set(L.px, g.terrain.heightAt(L.px, L.pz), L.pz); p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0); p.yaw = Math.atan2(-(L.x - L.px), -(L.z - L.pz)); p.pitch = -0.6; g.chunks.warmup(p.position); __tick(6); localStorage.setItem('__L', JSON.stringify({ id: L.id, x: L.x, z: L.z })); return { tronco: L.id, comprimento: +L.len.toFixed(1), madeiraDele: L.wood, alvoNaMira: g.tools.targetWood, acao: document.querySelector('.hud-action').textContent }; })()
label: tronco caído da mata na mira

eval: (() => { const g = game, L = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__L')); const antes = g.edits.wood; g.input.pressed.add('KeyE'); __tick(3); const ch = g.chunks.chunkAt(L.x, L.z); return { ganhou: g.edits.wood - antes, madeira: g.edits.wood, sumiuDoChunk: !ch.logs.some((l) => l.id === L.id), recolhido: g.edits.taken.has(L.id) }; })()

eval: (() => { const g = game, T = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__T')), L = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__L')); const ch = g.chunks.chunkAt(T.x, T.z); const lc = g.chunks.chunkAt(L.x, L.z); let toco = false; if (ch) ch.treeRefs.forEach((r, k) => { if (!r && Math.hypot(ch.trunks[k * 4] - T.x, ch.trunks[k * 4 + 1] - T.z) < 0.01) toco = true; }); return { madeira: g.edits.wood, placar: document.querySelector('.hud-score').textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(), cortadas: [...g.edits.cut], tocoContinua: ch ? toco : 'chunk fora', arvoreNaoVolta: ch ? !ch.treeRefs.some((r) => r && r.id === T.id) : 'chunk fora', troncoNaoVolta: lc ? !lc.logs.some((l) => l.id === L.id) : 'chunk fora', derrubadasNoChao: g.edits.felled.length }; })()
